details.description:
Looking for a biscuit that brings something new to the table? Meet Sunfeast Mom’s Magic Shines – a delightful take on the classic butter biscuit. Light, flaky layers come together in a crisp bite. Each one is enriched with a smooth buttery flavour and topped with a gentle sugar glaze that adds just the right hint of sweetness.
Whether you’re taking a chai break, catching up with loved ones, or simply indulging in some me-time, Mom’s Magic Shines makes every moment feel a little more special. It’s the kind of crunch that comforts, without ever feeling too heavy.
Crafted to charm with every bite, this biscuit brings a little magic to your everyday snacking moments.
details.storageInstructions: Store in a cool, dry place. Keep the pack sealed after opening.
